notes.title: Pause Houses and Emotion Balloons
notes.content:
🏠 Pause Houses
You can now pause the game! Just purchase a Pause House, and a new pause button will appear above the timer.

While paused, your fish will sleep safely. 😴

We're starting with 3 beautiful Pause Houses:



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/e8afbb8a8501c3f5bc42f9ab93d0c8c95d2d5552.png"]


[hr][/hr]💬 Emotion Balloons
Fish now display emotion balloons above their heads whenever their mood changes.
This makes it easier to understand how they’re feeling and take better care of them! ❤️🐟



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/d9f18eae1fef2204a870a4a19487523b98f92864.png"]


[hr][/hr]✅ Fixes & Improvements
Icons added to Store, Ranking, Settings, and Move buttons

Animated color change in the status ball when minimized

🐛 Bug Fix: Timer no longer stays active after closing and reopening the end-game screen

🐛 Bug Fix: Cause of death now clearly shown in red text

🐛 Bug Fix: Mouse icon now hidden during move action

🐛 Bug Fix: Screen position resets correctly after using the Help, Minimize, or Exit buttons

🐛 Bug Fix: All fish textures now display properly during the flop animation

🐛 Bug Fix: Local fish names now correctly shown in the ranking

notes.title: Don't kill the fish v1.1.0
notes.content:
What's New?

Card Purchase Mechanic: You can now use a debit card to buy items. Purchases are only made if you have enough money. There are 6 card levels—starting with a basic card that allows auto-buy for just 1 item. As your score increases, you unlock higher-level cards with greater auto-buy limits, making it easier to keep your fish safe. Click the card to enable or disable auto-buy for an item. For example, see the Plant item with auto-buy active.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/cce72fbd018211b53e9853f11527dab95c8d0d27.png"]


Automatic Help Consumable: A new consumable item has been added to help your fish. If your fish jumps out of the aquarium, you can now use the auto-help item to bring it back. Check how many you have by clicking the snail to open the settings. After 5 seconds, a help button will appear and automatically save your fish.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/a7e62fe919caf73d05974af243dec37c5b4f6dbc.png"]


Timer Improvements: The in-game timer now displays minutes and hours.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/1d4818203332486bbe9af359c1059086e0adeb42.png"]


Brightness Control: A brightness slider has been added to the settings menu.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627696/5f601708e0c6a25126e410559844c7209dae1995.png"]

Fixes and Improvements

Bug Fix: The ball no longer appears in the aquarium after auto-save when the game is minimized.

Bug Fix: Food no longer increases when the fish is dead.

Bug Fix: The game now loads without automatically opening menus.

Bug Fix: Menu panels now block the config panel from being hidden or shown while they are open.


By
